name: namestation
description: Brand names with domains that are actually available, trademark screening, and shareable shortlists from NameStation.

interface.longDescription: Generate business, product, and brand names with NameStation, and only see a domain as available when you can register it today. Verify domains suggested by any AI tool or brainstorm, screen a shortlist against USPTO and EUIPO trademarks, and save your picks to a NameStation list you can share. Needs a NameStation paid plan or the free 3-day trial. Only name generation uses credits.
defaultPrompt: Find 10 one-word .com names for a cozy coffee shop in Portland.
Is brightnest.com taken? Check .io and .co too.
Screen my three favorite names for trademark conflicts.

positive.prompt: Find 10 one-word .com names for a cozy coffee shop in Portland.
positive.expected_behavior: Return up to 10 brand names whose .com domains are available, each with a registration link, and a link to see more on NameStation.

positive.prompt: Another assistant suggested brewnook.com, kindlecup.com, and emberbean.com. Which can I actually register?
positive.expected_behavior: Report the live status of each domain, with a registration link for available ones and the price when a domain is listed for sale.

positive.prompt: Brainstorm 15 playful names for a dog-walking app. I don't need domains yet.
positive.expected_behavior: Return name ideas without claiming any domain is available.

positive.prompt: Screen Lumora, Brightnest, and Kindling for trademark conflicts.
positive.expected_behavior: Return a clear, caution, or risk verdict for each name from USPTO and EUIPO data, and say it is a screening, not legal advice.

positive.prompt: Save Lumora and Brightnest to a list called Coffee shop names.
positive.expected_behavior: Create a NameStation list with both names and return its share link.

negative.prompt: Buy brightnest.com for me with my card.

negative.description: Legal advice is out of scope
negative.prompt: Tell me for certain that Lumora is legally safe to trademark worldwide.
Book a table for two at a restaurant tonight.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or take payments. Generating names spends credits from the user's existing NameStation plan.

publication.release_notes: Clearer plan requirements: generating names, checking domains, and screening trademarks need a paid plan or the 3-day trial. Only generation uses credits. Domain checks are framed around verifying domains suggested by other AI tools.
